saw_lines: Advent calendars get bought as gifts, so the buyer is choosing for someone else and wants the reason in seconds.
So the sale is decided in the first line, before a gift buyer checks the price or delivery.
Your 7 of 17 ads open on the same advent shot moment line. Write two or three new openers from your 24 shot calendar and test each against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 7 of 17 ads open on the same advent shot moment line, so most of your account repeats one opening. Name two or three new angles from your 24 shot calendar and run each against it.
0 of 17 ads are video, so a gift buyer never sees the calendar opened. Shoot three short videos of it opened day by day and a shot in use, then run each against your oldest static ad.
One exact copy runs in 7 of 17 ads, so a buyer who sees two of them reads the same paragraph twice. Keep the body copy, but swap the opening line and the image in each of those 7.
None of your 17 ads carries a proof number, so a first time gift buyer has only the picture to judge by. Put your 4.8 rating on the creative in two ads, then test a review count against it.

ads_1: New openers from the 24 shot calendar, tested against the advent shot moment
